ci.scope: Full supported-version matrix, slow/rare tests and mutation campaigns; no local rerun after an unchanged passing result.
ci.status: Existing workflows; full branch triggers and timeout enforcement require separate CI integration.

notes: Use test-tier inner --changed PATH or --test tests/file.py::test_name. Unmapped changes require reviewed targets; no automatic full-suite fallback.
Budgets are aggregate worker command seconds, including uv setup: inner 120; pre_merge 3 x 600. Timeout is incomplete validation, never success.
Linux workers need uv, Python 3.12 provisioning and Graphviz for rendering tests. Dependency resolution failures are environment failures, not test passes.
Keep one process per shard until deterministic collection and xdist duration aggregation fixes are integrated. Shards share one seed and source revision.
Pre_merge excludes slow/rare only; CI retains them. No coverage claim for the inner selection. Existing baseline failures remain release blockers.
Map is deliberately partial; extend it with verified dependency knowledge. A test-only change selects that test file directly.
